evidence: Modifies src/index/txindex.cpp and txindex.h to support index queries on pruned nodes.
rationale: Enables txindex to run alongside block pruning, resolving four long-standing user feature requests dating back to 2017 (#10609, #12651, #16182, and #35240). Pruned node operators gain the ability to locate transactions across the full chain history without keeping full blocks on disk.
